introduction.text_001: The office side of a performing arts program.
introduction.text_002: Turn on the parts your program needs and leave the rest off. Each program chooses its own, and you can change your mind any time.
introduction.text_005: Fees, payments into your own account, every balance, plus ledgers and budgets for your boosters.
introduction.text_008: Fillable PDF forms, signatures and reminders, and a clear list of who hasn't signed.
introduction.text_011: Who has paid, signed and registered for every concert, competition and trip.
introduction.text_014: One roster with guardians and ensembles, and portals for parents and students.
introduction.text_016: Announcements, direct messages and one calendar for every rehearsal and event.
introduction.text_019: Every instrument and uniform, with who has it, what shape it's in and what it's worth.
introduction.text_022: Searchable repertoire, scores and parts, with digital parts and recordings if you want them.
introduction.text_025: Class seating from rankings, and concert charts that combine ensembles.
introduction.text_028: Skill Pathways, practice logs, curriculum, quizzes and attendance, with levels you can rename.

features.text_031: See it set up for your program.
